name: SoilGrids
tagline: Global soil property maps via REST for precision-ag planning
description: SoilGrids is an ISRIC REST API that provides globally consistent soil property predictions (texture fractions, pH, organic carbon, bulk density, and related layers) on a regular grid. Developers query by coordinates and depth intervals to retrieve modeled values and uncertainty for site assessment, agronomic planning, and environmental modeling without hosting the full soil map stacks.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public REST endpoints; requests are made directly without API keys or OAuth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public free access; no paid plans documented. Fair-use rate limiting applies (exact free quota not published as a numeric allowance).

rate_limits: not published as fixed numeric quotas; fair-use / anti-abuse throttling may apply (see ISRIC SoilGrids REST notes)
use_cases: get soil pH at a farm field lat/lon
fetch clay/silt/sand texture fractions for a plot
retrieve soil organic carbon stock for a depth interval
sample bulk density and related properties for site suitability
batch-query soil layers for precision-ag planning polygons (via multiple point queries)
